notes: B121.4 completes provisional subject-aware WeatherGrid coverage for all four active Qixingtan Opportunities.
Celestial subjects are not assigned fake terrestrial coordinates: sunrise uses an east-Pacific horizon sector; Milky Way uses local Camera-Zone sky/weather context.
The sunrise azimuth envelope is an astronomical all-season coverage envelope, not a claim about the exact solar azimuth on every date.
Entries marked needs_research intentionally remain incomplete; Place center fallback does not satisfy subject-aware coverage.

provenance.basis: Miaoli County tourism / Taiwan tourism multimedia Place-specific description: Yundong has a broad observation platform facing mountain ranges, overlooking Dahu and Sanyi with layered mountain scenery; the same Camera Zone already has an 8 km spatial-weather ring for tw-014-P02.
provenance.geometry_interpretation: Conservative full-ring coverage envelope around the verified observation platform. It intentionally over-covers the researched layered-mountain subject rather than claiming an exact visible ridgeline polygon.

subject_geometries.name: 雲洞山莊觀景平台層巒遠眺廣域 coverage

weather_coverage.note: 官方地點資料證實觀景平台可俯瞰大湖、三義與層疊山巒；因尚無精確可見山稜 polygon，沿用同一 Camera Zone 已研究的 8 km spatial-weather ring 作保守 coverage envelope。此 envelope 只保證氣象圖不裁掉相關山景區域，不宣稱 360° 全部都是實際構圖主體。

provenance.basis: Hualien County official photography feature identifies Qixingtan as a sunrise photography location and explicitly describes the sun rising from the Pacific to the east.
provenance.geometry_interpretation: The 60°–120° sector is a conservative annual sunrise-azimuth envelope for ~24°N centered on the documented east-Pacific sunrise subject. The 5 km subject range rounds the same official article's ~4.7 km sea-horizon distance discussion.

subject_geometries.name: 七星潭東向太平洋日出地平線

weather_coverage.note: 太陽本身是 celestial subject，不配置假 GPS。WeatherGrid 以已查證的東向太平洋日出地平線 sector 表示攝影主體方向；60°–120° 為約北緯24°全年日出方位的保守 envelope。

provenance.basis: Hualien County official night-tourism material explicitly identifies Qixingtan as a place to view starry sky and the Milky Way together with its sea scenery.
provenance.geometry_interpretation: Milky Way is celestial and its apparent orientation changes with date/time. B126 therefore does not invent a terrestrial subject point or fixed azimuth. Coverage is anchored to the verified Camera Zone as local sky/weather context; display padding and the provider interpolation halo supply surrounding atmospheric context.

environment_geometries.name: 七星潭賞星廣場 Camera Zone 在地天空／雲況 context

weather_coverage.note: 銀河為 celestial subject，方位隨日期與時刻改變，因此不建立固定地面 subject GPS/sector。此 coverage 僅要求 Camera Zone 與其在地天空氣象 context；未來若新增特定前景／特定銀河構圖，須另增相應 terrestrial foreground geometry。
